data.title: Phidata is an open-source framework for building A
data.content:
## Summary
Phidata is an open-source framework for building AI agents with local memory, knowledge, and tools. This update introduces an 'Agent UI' playground that allows users to interact with and monitor agents running locally, ensuring high privacy and ease of use.

## Key Points
- Launch of a new open-source playground UI for interacting with and engineering AI agents.
- Ability to run agents entirely locally using models like Llama 3.2 via Ollama or cloud models like GPT-4o.
- Privacy-focused architecture where data remains local and only the endpoint is shared with the Phidata app.
- Demonstration of domain-specific agents for finance, web search, research, and YouTube video summarization.
- Support for persistent local storage of sessions and memory using local database files.

## AI Concepts
AI Agents, Agentic AI systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Autonomous Assistants, LLM OS, Local Memory, Tool Calling
